theme_and_archetype.rationale: As a video creation platform, the UI must recede so the content (avatars/video) becomes the hero. A stark, high-contrast dark mode mimics professional editing software (e.g., Premiere, Resolve), establishing authority and avoiding the generic glowing-neon 'AI tool' slop.

heading.usage: H1, H2, Dashboard widget titles. Use tracking-tight.

body.usage: All body text, forms, navigation. Highly legible at small sizes.

mono.usage: Credit counters, video durations, character counts, technical metadata.

semantic.primary_action: White text on black (Light mode) / Black text on white (Dark mode). Stark contrast.
semantic.generate_button: Use hsl(0, 84%, 60%) (Signal Red) for the 'Generate Video' actions to mimic a recording studio 'REC' button. This stands out against the monochrome UI.

dashboard_grid.strategy: High density, clear functional separation. 1px solid borders, no shadows.
dashboard_grid.sidebar: w-64 fixed inset-y-0 left-0 border-r border-border bg-background z-40 hidden lg:block
dashboard_grid.topbar: h-16 border-b border-border bg-background/80 backdrop-blur-xl sticky top-0 z-30 flex items-center justify-between px-6

video_editor.left_panel: w-80 border-r border-border h-[calc(100vh-4rem)] overflow-y-auto p-4 (Avatar & Voice selection)
video_editor.center_canvas: flex-1 flex flex-col h-[calc(100vh-4rem)] bg-muted/30 p-6 (Preview player + Script editor)
video_editor.right_panel: w-72 border-l border-border h-[calc(100vh-4rem)] overflow-y-auto p-4 (Video Settings: Res, BG, Captions)

layout_and_spacing.spacing_scale: Use tight padding (p-4, p-6) for widgets to maintain control room density. Use larger margins (mb-8, mb-12) to separate major sections.

cards.style: Flat, 1px border, no box-shadows. Sharp or minimal border-radius (rounded-md).

buttons.primary: bg-primary text-primary-foreground hover:opacity-90 transition-opacity rounded-md font-medium px-4 py-2
buttons.generate: bg-accent text-accent-foreground hover:bg-accent/90 transition-colors rounded-md font-semibold px-6 py-2 shadow-[0_0_15px_rgba(239,68,68,0.2)]
buttons.ghost: hover:bg-muted text-muted-foreground hover:text-foreground transition-colors rounded-md px-3 py-2

inputs.style: Subtle borders, dark backgrounds, high focus contrast.
inputs.classes: bg-background border border-input focus:border-primary focus:ring-1 focus:ring-primary rounded-md px-3 py-2 text-sm
inputs.script_editor: w-full min-h-[200px] resize-none bg-background border border-input p-4 rounded-md font-body text-base leading-relaxed focus:outline-none focus:ring-1 focus:ring-primary

badges.style: Pill-shaped, subtle transparent background with colored border and text.
badges.classes: inline-flex items-center px-2.5 py-0.5 rounded-full text-xs font-medium border

interactions_and_motion.hover_states: All interactive elements MUST have explicit hover states (e.g., hover:bg-muted hover:text-foreground).
interactions_and_motion.transitions: Use 'transition-all duration-200 ease-in-out' for standard UI changes.
interactions_and_motion.micro_interactions: Avatar cards scale up slightly on hover ('hover:scale-[1.02] transition-transform').
interactions_and_motion.loading: Pulse animations on the 'Processing' status badge. Skeleton loaders for video grids while data fetches.

accessibility.testing_ids: MANDATORY: All buttons, links, inputs, and key info must have 'data-testid' (e.g., data-testid='create-video-btn', data-testid='dashboard-credits').
accessibility.contrast: Ensure text over muted backgrounds meets APCA guidelines. Use text-foreground for primary readable content.

instructions_to_main_agent.1: Enforce Dark Mode by default. The primary app wrapper should have the 'dark' class applied.
instructions_to_main_agent.2: Build pure HTML/Tailwind for layouts and use Shadcn components (heavily styled to match the brutalist/flat aesthetic) for logic.
instructions_to_main_agent.3: Use lucide-react for all icons to maintain consistency.
instructions_to_main_agent.4: The Video Editor must visually separate the setup (Left), script/preview (Center), and output settings (Right) strictly, mimicking an IDE like VS Code or Premiere.
instructions_to_main_agent.5: Do not use standard generic gradients or purple blobs. If background texture is needed, use a faint SVG noise or strict grid lines.
instructions_to_main_agent.6: Use native .js files for React components (as standard for this env, unless you setup TS explicitly), and inject fonts in index.css.
instructions_to_main_agent.7: Do not use placeholder text for images. Use the provided Unsplash URLs.
